main_text.p: sacræ paginæ professores, necnon Iac. Cole, & Ioan. Steuyns notarij nostri in hac parte assumpti, iurati e-rant omnes, et singulí ad sancta Dei Euangelia, tacto libro, quod de & super materia prædicta, ac in tota causa huiusmodi, suum fidele con-silium, & ministerium præberent, atque toto mundo. Consequenterq; comparuit dictus dominus Roberº tus de Morlay miles, custos turris London. ac præfatum dominum Ioannem Oldcastellum secum adduxit, & coram nobis statuit. Cui nobis affabiliter & suauiter recitaui mus acta prioris diei, ac ut prius recitauimus quomodo excomunicatus fuerat, & est, idem dominus Io. acrogauimus & requisiuimus eundem, quatenus peteret & admitteret in forma debita ecclesiæ absolutionem. Cui idem dominus Ioan. expresse respondit tunc ibide, quod nullam absolutionem in hac parte

page.notes: Heading not present. Catchword "peteret" at the lower right; the text also ends with the last full line. Some letters are faint, e.g. "Euangelia", "super", "idem": transcribed as read. Dash-form "re-" and "quod" are as printed. The running head is set in small capitals with a long-s form; the final letter "E" with a swash mark is kept as "E˒".
